summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its 1Q26 backlog and deliveries. Backlog reached a record $32.1 billion, up 22% YoY, with deliveries of 44 aircraft, up 47% YoY. Finnair placed an order for up to 46 E195-E2 aircraft. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No deal terms are present.
